The workflows are showing `action_required` (fork gate) — could a maintainer press "Approve and run workflows"? Local verification so the approval isn't a leap of faith, on `ce74f53` (up to date with `master`):

- `bundle exec rake spec` — full suite green (test-queue, all workers 0 failures)
- `bundle exec rake internal_investigation` — 126 files, no offenses
- `bundle exec rake documentation_syntax_check` — passes
- `bundle exec rspec spec/rubocop/cop/performance/array_semi_infinite_range_slice_spec.rb` — 11 examples, 0 failures (6 pre-existing + the new chained-slice case)
- `PARSER_ENGINE=parser_prism bundle exec rspec spec/rubocop/cop/performance/array_semi_infinite_range_slice_spec.rb` — green

The new spec (`array.slice(1..).slice(2..)`) fails on `master` with `Parser::ClobberingError` and passes with the fix.
